field_notes.text: a guess from cuellars description is the ships are pushed into the heavy surf on a breaker line probably a parallel sandbar (we infer  this is likely as the beach itself is a large parallel sand bar creating a large lagoon, unusual topography in ireland even. the ships lean an break up rapidly and heavy guns would possibly accelrate this as the high castles collapse -- we might hypotheseis the highest mounted swivels might be found inshore from the keel - just a hypothesis but something to test
